```{r}
############################################################
# METHOD 1 SIMULATION: Logistic GLM (linear MVPA) + Wald CI
# Outputs: bias, MSE, coverage, expected CI width, runtime
############################################################
set.seed(406)

inv_logit <- function(z) 1/(1+exp(-z))

# --- DGP settings (common across all methods) ---
beta0 <- -1.2
beta1 <- -0.06         # TRUE MVPA slope (target parameter)
betaF <-  0.35
beta2 <-  0.01         # quadratic term for Scenario B
betaInt <- -0.05       # interaction for Scenario C

# Generate covariates (synthetic, fast, no real data required)
gen_X <- function(n) {
  mvpa <- pmin(pmax(round(rnorm(n, mean = 6, sd = 3)), 0), 15)   # 0–15-ish
  female <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.52)
  data.frame(mvpa_week = mvpa, female = female)
}

# Generate outcomes under 3 scenarios
genY_A <- function(X) {
  eta <- beta0 + beta1*X$mvpa_week + betaF*X$female
  rbinom(nrow(X), 1, inv_logit(eta))
}
genY_B <- function(X) {
  eta <- beta0 + beta1*X$mvpa_week + beta2*(X$mvpa_week^2) + betaF*X$female
  rbinom(nrow(X), 1, inv_logit(eta))
}
genY_C <- function(X) {
  eta <- beta0 + beta1*X$mvpa_week + betaF*X$female + betaInt*(X$mvpa_week*X$female)
  rbinom(nrow(X), 1, inv_logit(eta))
}

fit_m1 <- function(df, alpha = 0.05) {
  fit <- glm(obese ~ mvpa_week + female, family = binomial(), data = df)
  b1 <- unname(coef(fit)["mvpa_week"])
  se <- unname(sqrt(vcov(fit)["mvpa_week","mvpa_week"]))
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
  ci <- c(b1 - z*se, b1 + z*se)
  list(est = b1, ci = ci)
}

run_m1 <- function(genY, scenario_name, M = 500, n = 3000) {
  est <- numeric(M); cover <- numeric(M); width <- numeric(M); rt <- numeric(M)
  for (m in 1:M) {
    if (m %% 25 == 0) message(scenario_name, ": ", m, "/", M)
    X <- gen_X(n)
    y <- genY(X)
    df <- cbind(X, obese = y)

    t0 <- proc.time()[3]
    out <- fit_m1(df)
    rt[m] <- proc.time()[3] - t0

    est[m] <- out$est
    cover[m] <- as.numeric(out$ci[1] <= beta1 && beta1 <= out$ci[2])
    width[m] <- out$ci[2] - out$ci[1]
  }
  data.frame(
    scenario = scenario_name,
    M = M, n = n,
    truth_beta1 = beta1,
    bias = mean(est - beta1),
    mc_sd = sd(est),
    mse = mean((est - beta1)^2),
    coverage = mean(cover),
    exp_width = mean(width),
    mean_runtime_sec = mean(rt)
  )
}

# --- Run scenarios ---
res_A <- run_m1(genY_A, "A_linear", M = 300, n = 3000)
res_B <- run_m1(genY_B, "B_quadratic", M = 300, n = 3000)
res_C <- run_m1(genY_C, "C_interaction", M = 300, n = 3000)

out <- rbind(res_A, res_B, res_C)
print(out)
saveRDS(out, file = "method1_glm_wald_results.rds")
```
